lines.label: B1
lines.reason: A ~90 deg front down-flange along the +x edge, running corner to corner. In the perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the line sits within 0.03-0.16 mm of the outermost outer-skin point. The fold arc occupies t of about -2 to 374 mm and the line is 372.9 mm. Parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: A ~90 deg tall tab at the -y front corner. The sections put the line on the outer apex, 0.10-0.24 mm off. The fold, where tab and base meet, runs about 47 mm from the tab edge to the corner relief near B1, and the line is 44.7 mm. The end views confirm the line stops at the relief.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: A ~98 deg tall tab at the +y front corner, with the line on the outer apex at 25/50/75% (0.10-0.19 mm). The tab runs out to x=+28 but the base is relieved past about +23, so the shared fold arc is about 46 mm and the line is 42.4 mm. The normal-angle profile of the tab shows a smooth, decaying roll of about 8-12 deg over 6-20 mm from the apex (17, 8, 5, 3, 2, 1 deg per 3 mm bin). That roll has no crease, so it is part of this bend and not a separate line.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: A 90 deg short tab at the +y back corner. The line was fitted from inner-skin planes, but the sections show it on the outer arc apex (0.26-0.33 mm). The fold arc is about 49 mm and the line is 47.1 mm.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: A ~66 deg short tab at the -y back corner, leaning outward. The line is on the outer apex in all three sections (0.17-0.34 mm). The fold arc is about 50 mm and the line is 47.4 mm. The base next to it tilts up to about 7 deg and decays within about 15 mm. That is under 10 deg and has no crease, so it is not a bend.
